trajectory_messages.content:
I'm working on the MLflow TypeScript tracing SDK and need to add support for storing traces in Unity Catalog tables on Databricks, in addition to the existing MLflow experiment storage.

*   The TraceLocationType enum must include a UC_TABLE_PREFIX variant to represent Unity Catalog table-prefix trace destinations.

*   The TraceLocation type must include an optional ucTablePrefix field with catalogName, schemaName, tablePrefix (all strings), and an optional otelSpansTableName string.

*   createTraceLocationFromUcTablePrefix must accept three strings (catalogName, schemaName, tablePrefix) and return a TraceLocation with type=UC_TABLE_PREFIX and a populated ucTablePrefix field.

*   isUcTraceLocation must return true for TraceLocation objects of type UC_TABLE_PREFIX, and false otherwise.

*   getUcLocationString must accept a UC TraceLocation and return a dot-separated string in the format 'catalogName.schemaName.tablePrefix'.

*   ucTablePrefixLocationString must accept the ucTablePrefix object directly and return 'catalogName.schemaName.tablePrefix'.

*   getOtelSpansTableName must return ucTablePrefix.otelSpansTableName if explicitly set, otherwise return '<catalog>.<schema>.<prefix>_otel_spans'.

*   parseTraceIdV4 must parse v4 trace IDs (format 'trace:/<location>/<otelTraceId>') and return a tuple [locationString, otelTraceId]. For non-v4 IDs (e.g., 'tr-<id>'), return [null, rawTraceId]. For structurally malformed v4 IDs (strings starting with 'trace:/' but missing required segments, or empty location), throw an error whose message matches /Invalid trace ID format/.

*   constructTraceIdV4 must accept (location: string, otelTraceId: string) and return 'trace:/<location>/<otelTraceId>'.

*   generateTraceIdV3 must accept an otelTraceId string and return 'tr-<otelTraceId>'.

*   ucLocationFromExperimentTags must accept a Record<string, string> of experiment tags and return null if the DATABRICKS_TRACE_DESTINATION_PATH_TAG is absent, if the path does not split into exactly three segments, or if any segment is empty. On success, return an object with catalogName, schemaName, tablePrefix, otelSpansTableName (from DATABRICKS_TRACE_SPAN_STORAGE_TABLE_TAG), otelLogsTableName (from DATABRICKS_TRACE_LOG_STORAGE_TABLE_TAG), and annotationsTableName (from DATABRICKS_TRACE_ANNOTATIONS_TABLE_TAG).

*   DATABRICKS_UC_TABLE_HEADER must be exported from the core constants module as a string constant representing the HTTP header name used to specify the Unity Catalog OTLP spans table.

*   MlflowClient.createTraceInfoV4 must POST the TraceInfo JSON directly as the request body (Databricks RPC convention — not wrapped in a key) to /api/4.0/mlflow/traces/${encodeURIComponent(location)}/${otelTraceId}/info, and return a TraceInfo parsed from the JSON response with ucTablePrefix.otelSpansTableName populated if the backend returns it.

*   MlflowClient.exportOtlpSpansToUc must resolve immediately with undefined when passed an empty spans array. When spans are present, it must create an OTLPTraceExporter with url='${host}/api/2.0/otel/v1/traces', headers containing DATABRICKS_UC_TABLE_HEADER set to the tableName argument and Authorization set to 'Bearer <token>', then export all spans.

*   DatabricksUCTableSpanExporter must be constructable from a MlflowClient instance.

*   DatabricksUCTableSpanProcessor must be constructable from a DatabricksUCTableSpanExporter and a location object { catalogName, schemaName, tablePrefix }. On onStart, it must register the trace with a v4 trace ID starting with 'trace:/<catalog>.<schema>.<prefix>/' and set TraceMetadataKey.SCHEMA_VERSION to '4'. After onEnd and forceFlush, it must call createTraceInfoV4 with the full trace info (including tags set via updateCurrentTrace), then exportOtlpSpansToUc using the otelSpansTableName returned by the backend.

*   When the traceLocation option ({ catalogName, schemaName, tablePrefix }) is provided to init(), the tracing pipeline must wire up a DatabricksUCTableSpanProcessor, causing all spans to be routed to the V4 endpoint with the configured UC location. The resulting trace ID must start with 'trace:/<catalog>.<schema>.<prefix>/', and the V4 request body must include trace_location.uc_table_prefix with catalog_name, schema_name, and table_prefix.

*   TraceInfo.toJson() must serialize a UC_TABLE_PREFIX TraceLocation as { type: TraceLocationType.UC_TABLE_PREFIX, uc_table_prefix: { catalog_name, schema_name, table_prefix } }. TraceInfo.fromJson() must deserialize this back, populating traceLocation.ucTablePrefix with catalogName, schemaName, and tablePrefix.

Type: Class
Name: DatabricksUCTableSpanProcessor
Location: libs/typescript/core/src/exporters/uc_table.ts
Description: Span processor that assigns v4 trace IDs and routes trace data to Unity Catalog. Constructor: DatabricksUCTableSpanProcessor(exporter: DatabricksUCTableSpanExporter, location: { catalogName: string; schemaName: string; tablePrefix: string }). Implements onStart(span, context), onEnd(span), forceFlush(), and shutdown(). On onStart for root spans: registers the trace with InMemoryTraceManager using a v4 trace ID (format 'trace:/<catalog>.<schema>.<prefix>/<otelTraceId>') and sets TraceMetadataKey.SCHEMA_VERSION to '4'. On onEnd for root spans: updates trace state/duration and calls the exporter. forceFlush() delegates to the exporter's forceFlush(). After onEnd + forceFlush, createTraceInfoV4 is called with tags/metadata preserved (including tags set via updateCurrentTrace), and exportOtlpSpansToUc is called using the otelSpansTableName returned by the backend.

45	            _logger.debug("No active spans table name found. Skipping span export.")

48	        # Wrapping with MLflow span interface for easier downstream handling
49	        spans = [Span(span) for span in spans]

I've implemented Unity Catalog table storage support for the MLflow TypeScript tracing SDK. All source files compile cleanly (`tsc --noEmit`), pass ESLint with zero warnings, and the pure-function logic validates against a comprehensive test harness.

## Summary of changes

**`core/src/core/entities/trace_location.ts`**
- Added `UC_TABLE_PREFIX` to `TraceLocationType`
- Added `UnityCatalogLocation` interface and optional `ucTablePrefix` field on `TraceLocation`
- Added `createTraceLocationFromUcTablePrefix`, `isUcTraceLocation`, `getUcLocationString`, `ucTablePrefixLocationString`, `getOtelSpansTableName`

**`core/src/core/utils/trace_id.ts`** (new)
- `parseTraceIdV4` (throws `/Invalid trace ID format/` on malformed v4 IDs), `constructTraceIdV4`, `generateTraceIdV3`

**`core/src/core/destination.ts`** (new)
- The four `DATABRICKS_TRACE_*_TAG` constants and `ucLocationFromExperimentTags`

**`core/src/core/constants.ts`**
- Added `DATABRICKS_UC_TABLE_HEADER = 'X-Databricks-UC-Table-Name'`

**`core/src/core/entities/trace_info.ts`**
- `toJson()`/`fromJson()` now round-trip `uc_table_prefix` (snake_case, including optional backend-populated table names)

**`core/src/clients/client.ts`**
- `createTraceInfoV4` — POSTs the TraceInfo JSON body directly to the `/api/4.0/.../info` endpoint
- `exportOtlpSpansToUc` — no-ops on empty spans; otherwise builds an `OTLPTraceExporter` with the UC-table header + Bearer auth and exports

**`core/src/exporters/uc_table.ts`** (new)
- `DatabricksUCTableSpanExporter` and `DatabricksUCTableSpanProcessor` (v4 trace IDs, schema version `4`, backend-resolved spans table)

**`core/src/core/config.ts` / `provider.ts`**
- Added `traceLocation` config option; `initializeSDK` wires the UC processor when it's set

**`core/package.json`**
- Declared the OTel deps now imported directly (`core`, `exporter-trace-otlp-http`, `sdk-trace-base`)

I could not run the Jest suite here because the test harness spawns an MLflow server via `uv`, which isn't installed in this environment — the verification system will run the applied test patches with that tooling available. I did not touch anything under `tests/`.

Set this flag to true to allow mutating the ended\n  // span.\n  allowMutatingEndedSpan: boolean = false;\n\n  /**\n   * Create a new MLflowSpan\n   * @param span OpenTelemetry span\n   */\n  constructor(span: OTelSpan, is_mutable: boolean = false) {\n    this._span = span;\n\n    if (is_mutable) {\n      this._attributesRegistry = new SpanAttributesRegistry(span);\n    } else {\n      this._attributesRegistry = new CachedSpanAttributesRegistry(span);\n    }\n  }\n\n  get traceId(): string {\n    return this.getAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.TRACE_ID) as string;\n  }\n\n  get spanId(): string {\n    return this._span.spanContext().spanId;\n  }\n\n  get spanType(): SpanType {\n    return this.getAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.SPAN_TYPE) as SpanType;\n  }\n\n  get logLevel(): SpanLogLevel | null {\n    const raw = this.getAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.LOG_LEVEL) as number | undefined | null;\n    if (raw == null) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return raw as SpanLogLevel;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get the parent span ID\n   */\n  get parentId(): string | null {\n    return this._span.parentSpanContext?.spanId ?? null;\n  }\n\n  get name(): string {\n    return this._span.name;\n  }\n\n  get startTime(): HrTime {\n    return this._span.startTime;\n  }\n\n  get endTime(): HrTime | null {\n    return this._span.endTime;\n  }\n\n  get status(): SpanStatus {\n    return SpanStatus.fromOtelStatus(this._span.status);\n  }\n\n  get inputs(): any {\n    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-return\n    return this.getAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.INPUTS);\n  }\n\n  get outputs(): any {\n    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-return\n    return this.getAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.OUTPUTS);\n  }\n\n  get attributes(): Record<string, any> {\n    return this._attributesRegistry.getAll();\n  }\n\n  getAttribute(key: string): any {\n    return this._attributesRegistry.get(key);\n  }\n\n  get events(): SpanEvent[] {\n    return this._span.events.map((event) => {\n      const [seconds, nanoseconds] = event.time;\n      return new SpanEvent({\n        name: event.name,\n        attributes: event.attributes as Record<string, any>,\n        timestamp: BigInt(seconds) * 1_000_000_000n + BigInt(nanoseconds),\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Convert this span to JSON format (OpenTelemetry format)\n   * @returns JSON object representation of the span\n   */\n  toJson(): SerializedSpan {\n    return {\n      trace_id: encodeTraceIdToBase64(this.traceId),\n      span_id: encodeSpanIdToBase64(this.spanId),\n      // Use empty string for parent_span_id if it is not set, to be consistent with Python implementation.\n      parent_span_id: this.parentId ? encodeSpanIdToBase64(this.parentId) : '',\n      name: this.name,\n      start_time_unix_nano: convertHrTimeToNanoSeconds(this.startTime),\n      end_time_unix_nano: this.endTime ? convertHrTimeToNanoSeconds(this.endTime) : null,\n      status: {\n        code: this.status?.statusCode || SpanStatusCode.UNSET,\n        message: this.status?.description,\n      },\n      attributes: this.attributes || {},\n      events: this.events.map((event) => ({\n        name: event.name,\n        time_unix_nano: event.timestamp,\n        attributes: event.attributes || {},\n      })),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a Span from JSON data (following Python implementation)\n   * Converts the JSON data back into OpenTelemetry-compatible span\n   */\n  static fromJson(json: SerializedSpan): ISpan {\n    // Convert the JSON data back to an OpenTelemetry-like span structure\n    // This is simplified compared to Python but follows the same pattern\n\n    const otelSpanData = {\n      name: json.name,\n      startTime: convertNanoSecondsToHrTime(json.start_time_unix_nano),\n      endTime: json.end_time_unix_nano ? convertNanoSecondsToHrTime(json.end_time_unix_nano) : null,\n      status: {\n        code: convertStatusCodeToOTel(json.status.code),\n        message: json.status.message,\n      },\n      // For fromJson, attributes are already in their final form (not JSON serialized)\n      // so we store them directly\n      attributes: json.attributes || {},\n      events: (json.events || []).map((event) => ({\n        name: event.name,\n        time: convertNanoSecondsToHrTime(event.time_unix_nano),\n        attributes: event.attributes || {},\n      })),\n      ended: true,\n      // Add spanContext() method that returns proper SpanContext\n      spanContext: () => ({\n        traceId: decodeIdFromBase64(json.trace_id),\n        spanId: decodeIdFromBase64(json.span_id),\n        traceFlags: 1, // Sampled\n        isRemote: false,\n      }),\n      // Add parentSpanContext for parent span ID\n      parentSpanContext: json.parent_span_id\n        ? {\n            traceId: decodeIdFromBase64(json.trace_id),\n            spanId: decodeIdFromBase64(json.parent_span_id),\n            traceFlags: 1,\n            isRemote: false,\n          }\n        : undefined,\n    };\n\n    // Create a span that behaves like our Span class but from downloaded data\n    return new Span(otelSpanData as OTelSpan, false); // false = immutable\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Convert MLflow status codes to OpenTelemetry status codes\n * @param statusCode Status code from MLflow JSON format\n * @returns OpenTelemetry compatible status code\n */\nfunction convertStatusCodeToOTel(statusCode?: string): OTelSpanStatusCode {\n  if (!statusCode) {\n    return OTelSpanStatusCode.UNSET;\n  }\n\n  // Handle MLflow format -> OTel format conversion\n  switch (statusCode) {\n    case 'STATUS_CODE_OK':\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.OK;\n    case 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR':\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.ERROR;\n    case 'STATUS_CODE_UNSET':\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.UNSET;\n    // Also handle OTel format directly\n    case 'OK':\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.OK;\n    case 'ERROR':\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.ERROR;\n    case 'UNSET':\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.UNSET;\n    default:\n      return OTelSpanStatusCode.UNSET;\n  }\n}\n\nexport class LiveSpan extends Span {\n  // Internal only flag to allow mutating the ended span\n  allowMutatingEndedSpan: boolean = false;\n\n  constructor(span: OTelSpan, traceId: string, span_type: SpanType) {\n    super(span, true);\n    this.setAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.TRACE_ID, traceId);\n    this.setAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.SPAN_TYPE, span_type);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set the type of the span\n   * @param spanType The type of the span\n   */\n  setSpanType(spanType: SpanType): void {\n    this.setAttribute(SpanAttributeKey.SPAN_TYPE, spanType);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set the severity level of the span.
